name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Après le § 32 - Am 49
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 32c. Calls on the Council to amend Council Regulation (EU) 2016/300 in order to abolish the transitional allowance for the President of the European Council and Commissioners, replacing it with access to national unemployment benefits under the same conditions as other workers;
